story.title: GOODWILL NORTH CENTRAL TEXAS ANNOUNCES NEW HASLET STORE AND DONATION CENTER
story.summary: FORT WORTH, TEXAS (November 17, 2026) – Goodwill North Central Texas is expanding its retail presence in northern Tarrant County with a new store and donation center planned in Haslet, facing U.S. Highway 287 just southeast of its intersection with Blue Mound Road. The 13,000-square-foot location will give residents a convenient new place to shop, […]
